title: Woo Tsung Wo

page_data.en:
Please return this file to the
CENTRAL REGISTRY
when finished with.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）

POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Commandant,
S.M.C.
Shanghai Municipal Council.
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No....................
Date.................... February 28th 1916

Sir,
Commencing from 26th instant nobody is allowed
on the roads near the Arsenal after 6 p.m.
With reference to the report of 25th instant
concerning the arrival of a high military officer
named Woo Tsung Wo 何振華 from Peking, the officer
in question has now gone to Nanking.
Before daylight on 26th instant the cruiser Hai
Yung 海荣 left the Arsenal for Nanking with 12 field
guns and several boxes of ammunition on board.
It is reported that six detectives arrived at the
Arsenal from Peking yesterday. These will make enquiries
about the general situation in Shanghai and will report
the result to the Central Government.
Three detectives from Peking arrived at Woosung
on 25th instant. Their mission is reported to be the
same as that of the men at the Arsenal.
General Yang has instructed all the coffin guilds
in the vicinity of the Arsenal to the effect that all
persons sending them coffins should furnish shop
security that the contents of the coffin are what they
purport to be.
It is reported that a rebel colonel named Koo Zung
Li 顾承直 has left here for Chefoo on orders from Sun
Yat Sen. It appears that the latter entertains hopes
of starting a rising in the Northern port.
A meeting of the Shanghai gentry was held in the
Bubbling Well temple at 4 p.m. 27th instant to consider
what action would be taken in connection with irregular
conduct on the part of the head priest, who has secretly
rented 5 mow of land belonging to the temple to Brandt
and Rodgers on a thirty years lease. At the meeting the
priest promised to have the agreement cancelled, and the
gentry agreed to postpone taking action for the time being.

Your Obedient Servant,

[Signature]

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

[Handwritten note at bottom]

中央登记处

（印章：上海工部局）

警务处，
（侦探科）

致司令官，
上海工部局。
刑事侦缉处。
I. O. REG
编号....................
日期.................... 1916年2月28日

先生，
自本月26日起，下午6时后，任何人不得进入兵工厂附近的道路。
关于本月25日有关一位名为何振華（Woo Tsung Wo）的高级军官从北京抵达的报告，该军官现已前往南京。
本月26日天亮前，巡洋舰“海荣”号（Hai Yung）载有12门野战炮及数箱弹药，从兵工厂启程前往南京。
据报，六名侦探昨日从北京抵达兵工厂。这些人将对上海的一般局势进行调查，并将结果报告给中央政府。
三名来自北京的侦探于本月25日抵达吴淞。据报，他们的任务与在兵工厂的人员相同。
杨将军已指示兵工厂附近的所有棺材行会，凡向其提供棺材者，须由店铺担保，确保棺内物品确如其所称。
据报，一名名为顾承直（Koo Zung Li）的叛军上校已奉孙中山之命离开此地前往芝罘。看来后者希望在北方港口发动起义。
本月27日下午4时，上海士绅在静安寺举行会议，商议针对该寺住持不当行为采取何种行动，该住持秘密将属于寺庙的5亩土地以三十年租期出租给 Brandt 和 Rodgers。会上，住持承诺取消该协议，士绅们同意暂时推迟采取行动。

您忠实的仆人，

[签名]

首席侦探督察。

警务处总监。

[底部手写备注]
